Class PackageDeal

java.lang.Object
model.PackageDeal
public class PackageDeal extends Object
Represents a combined package deal containing a flight and a hotel. Includes smart destination-matching logic to pair flights and hotels cleanly.

    • normalizeDestination

      public static String normalizeDestination(String destination)
      Normalizes a location or destination string by converting to lowercase, stripping parenthetical airport codes/indicators, removing punctuation, and collapsing whitespace.
      Parameters:
      destination - raw location string (e.g. "Tokyo (NRT)")
      Returns:
      normalized destination string (e.g. "tokyo")

    • isDestinationMatch

      public static boolean isDestinationMatch(String flightArrival, String hotelLocation)
      Evaluates whether a flight's arrival destination matches a hotel's location. Handles string normalization and bidirectional matching to ignore airport codes or minor suffix variations.
      Parameters:
      flightArrival - the flight arrival destination (e.g., "Tokyo (NRT)")
      hotelLocation - the hotel location city/region (e.g., "Tokyo")
      Returns:
      true if destinations match; false otherwise
